title: Vector Gravity Unites Dark Energy in the Universe and Elementary Particles, and Explains Arrow of Time
content:
We review arguments showing that Big Bang, subsequent cosmic inflation, present accelerating expansion of the universe (dark energy) and lightness of elementary particles have the same physical origin. Namely, these phenomena are manifestations of the negative value of the gravitational field energy in the vector theory of gravity, which causes these effects and yields value of the cosmological constant and masses of elementary particles in excellent agreement with experiment without free parameters. We also explain how arrow of time emerges in vector gravity. According to the latter, universe is a region of 4-dimensional space with geometry of Minkowski signature, embedded in a fixed Euclidean background. The theory predicts that cosmic inflation exponentially expands the spatial size of the universe and exponentially contracts its temporal size. As a result, size of the universe along the temporal dimension is close to zero, and universe as a whole is moving through the Euclidean background along the time direction,
which yields a unidirectional flow of time.
